protocol.status: FROZEN before any fresh-seed (100-119) or ablation-seed (200-209) run
protocol.method_name: BracketNet (revised): closure-regularized fit-close-refit with validation-selected closure weight
protocol.note: This is a REVISED method. It is not a reproduction of the original manuscript's lambda=0.1 protocol; lambda=0.1 at the same budget is evaluated as a reference variant 'bracketnet_lam0.1'.

data.observation_map: x = Qz + 0.18 tanh(Bz), p = d, one fixed map per group (seeds 101/102/103), shared by all splits

training.schedule: staged: lambda=0 for first 35 % of updates, linear ramp to lambda by 70 %, generators frozen for final 30 %
training.loss: 4 L_rec + 32 L_loc,lat + 2 L_loc,obs + 1.2 L_comp (comp/BracketNet) + lambda(t) L_close + 1 L_basis(2I) + 16 ||Cov(z) - I||_F^2
training.optimizer: AdamW, lr 2e-3, wd 1e-5, batch 160, global grad-norm clip 5
training.model_selection: none: the final iterate is evaluated (no early stopping, no checkpoint selection)

metrics: generator rank, singular values, Gram condition
ground-truth algebra distance and coverage after Procrustes
CKA and Procrustes residual vs truth
cross-seed algebra distance / CKA / action disagreement
evaluation.statistics: One-sided, final BracketNet vs +Comp. on fresh seeds, Holm-corrected over the family: H1 closure (T2, SO3); H2 ground-truth algebra distance (T2, SO3); H3 cross-seed algebra distance on disjoint seed pairs (T2, SO3). Test: exact paired sign-flip test on per-seed (or per-pair) differences. Transport, transfer and all other quantities are secondary and reported two-sided without claims of significance unless the 95 % CI excludes zero.
evaluation.thresholds: Structural categories (fixed here, before any fresh-seed result): collapsed if sigma_min/sigma_max of the generator matrix B < 0.1; closed if closure residual <= 0.01 * (mean closure of random sqrt(2)-normalized K-spans of so(d)); correct-closed if closed and ground-truth algebra distance <= 0.1 * chance distance; incorrect-closed otherwise (for SO3, subtype 'chiral' if participation ratio >= 3); 'accurate structure, inaccurate action' if correct-closed and normalized action disagreement with the ground truth > 0.5.

closure_objective_decision.rule: switch only if whitened is better on both
